source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 5 (PDF 93-118), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Solids and Fluid Dynamics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What makes steel hard and lead soft?
(Steel sakht aur lead naram kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh material ki banawat (structure) par munhasir hai: us ke atoms aur molecules ki khaas tarteeb aur bonding. Materials ka istemaal sakhti, ductility aur malleability jaisi khususiyaat par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: It depends upon the structure, the particular order and bonding of atoms and molecules in a material.

blocks.prompt:
2 What are crystalline solids? Give two examples.
(Crystalline solids kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Woh solids jin mein atoms aur molecules ki baqaida tarteeb ho; har molecule ke parosi poore crystal mein aik jaise pattern mein hon (munazzam banawat). Misalein: quartz, diamond (calcite, sugar, mica bhi).

book_ref.quote: There is, thus, an ordered structure in crystalline solids.

blocks.prompt:
3 Why does a crystalline solid have a definite melting point?
(Crystalline solid ka melting point muqarrar kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ke atoms muqarrar nuqton ke gird vibrate karte hain aur temperature ke saath amplitude barhta hai. Cohesive forces tarteeb qaim rakhti hain, magar aik khaas temperature par vibrations itni barh jati hain ke banawat achanak toot jati hai. Is liye tarteeb se be-tarteebi ki tabdeeli aik muqarrar temperature par achanak hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: For every crystal, however, there is a temperature at which the vibrations become greater that the structure suddenly breaks up

blocks.prompt:
4 Why are amorphous solids also called glassy solids?
(Amorphous solids ko glassy solids kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh aam glass jaisa rawayya rakhte hain: glass mein molecules ki baqaida tarteeb nahi aur garam karne par yeh aahista aahista paste jaisa naram ho kar (takreeban 800 °C par) bohat gaarha liquid banta hai. Aise solids ka melting point muqarrar nahi.

book_ref.quote: Thus, amorphous solids are also called glassy solids.

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between crystalline and amorphous solids.
(Crystalline aur amorphous solids mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Crystalline solids munazzam hain aur achanak pighalte hain; amorphous be-tarteeb hain aur aahista naram hote hain.

book_ref.quote: in amorphous solids there is no regular arrangement of molecules like that in crystalline solids

rows: Atoms aur molecules ki baqaida tarteeb.
Baqaida tarteeb nahi; jami hui be-tarteebi wala liquid.
Melting point muqarrar; achanak pighalte hain.
Melting point muqarrar nahi; aahista naram hote hain.
Misalein: quartz, calcite, sugar, mica, diamond.

blocks.prompt:
6 What are polymeric solids? Give two examples.
(Polymeric solids kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Polymers aise solids hain jin ki banawat tarteeb aur be-tarteebi ke darmiyan ho (juzwi crystalline). Yeh polymerization se bante hain jis mein saada molecules jur kar lambi zanjeerein banate hain. Misalein: polythene, nylon (polystyrene, qudrati rubber bhi).

book_ref.quote: They can be classified as partially or poorly crystalline solids.

blocks.prompt:
7 Why are polymers useful as light but strong materials?
(Polymers halke magar mazboot material kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Polymers ki specific gravity sab se halki dhaaton se bhi kam hai, phir bhi un ka strength to weight ratio achha hai.

book_ref.quote: and yet exhibit good strength to weight ratio

blocks.prompt:
8 What is deformation? Give an example.
(Deformation kya hai? Aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Deformation (bigaar) bairooni force lagne se shakal, lambai ya hajm mein tabdeeli hai. Misaal: naram rubber ki gend dabane se shakal badalti hai; rubber ki dori khenchne se lambai barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: From these examples, it is concluded that deformation

blocks.prompt:
9 Define elasticity. Explain it in terms of atoms.
(Elasticity ki definition likhein aur atoms ki madad se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Elasticity (lachak) jism ki apni asal shakal mein wapas aane ki salahiyat hai. Bairooni force atoms ko equilibrium se hatati hai (jism stress mein hota hai); force hatne par atoms wapas aate hain aur jism asal shakal pa leta hai, ba-shart force zyada na ho.

book_ref.quote: After the removal of external force, the atoms return to their equilibrium position

blocks.prompt:
10 Define stress and write its SI unit.
(Stress ki definition aur SI unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Stress woh force hai jo fi unit area lagai jaye taake shakal, hajm ya lambai badle: σ = F/A. SI unit N m⁻² hai jise pascal (Pa) kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The SI unit of stress (σ) is newton per square meter (N m⁻²)

blocks.prompt:
11 Name the three kinds of stress according to the change they produce.
(Paida hone wali tabdeeli ke lehaaz se stress ki teen qisamein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Tensile stress lambai badalta hai; volume stress hajm badalta hai; shear stress shakal badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Stress may cause a change in length, volume and shape.

blocks.prompt:
12 Define strain. Why does it have no unit?
(Strain ki definition likhein. Is ki unit kyun nahi hoti?)
blocks.explanation: Strain stress ke tehat solid ki deformation ka paimana hai; aik dimension mein yeh lambai ki fractional tabdeeli ε = ΔL/L₀ hai. Yeh do lambaiyon ki nisbat hai, is liye dimensionless hai aur unit nahi.

book_ref.quote: In the case of deformation in one dimension, strain is defined as the fractional change in length.

blocks.prompt:
13 Differentiate between tensile strain and compressive strain.
(Tensile strain aur compressive strain mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq us stress ka hai jo strain paida karta hai.

book_ref.quote: If strain ε is due to tensile stress σ, it is called tensile strain

blocks.prompt:
14 Define shear strain. How is it related to the angle θ?
(Shear strain ki definition likhein. Yeh angle θ se kaise juri hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar jism ke do aamne saamne ke rukh y faasle par hon aur shear stress se aik rukh Δx khiske to shear strain γ = Δx/y = tan θ hai. Chhote angle θ (radian) ke liye tan θ ≅ θ, is liye γ = θ.

book_ref.quote: then shear strain is produced which is is given by

blocks.prompt:
15 What is volumetric strain?
(Volumetric strain kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab stress jism ka hajm badle to fi unit hajm, hajm ki tabdeeli ΔV/V₀ volumetric strain hai. Is ki koi unit nahi.

book_ref.quote: the change in volume per unit volume is known as volumetric strain

blocks.prompt:
16 Define Young's modulus and give its SI unit.
(Young's modulus ki definition aur SI unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Young's modulus fi unit strain lagaya gaya stress hai: Y = tensile stress / tensile strain = (F/A)/(ΔL/L₀). Is ki unit stress wali N m⁻² ya Pa hai kyunke strain ki unit nahi.

book_ref.quote: It has the same unit as that of stress i.e., N m⁻² or Pa.

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate between tensile stress and shear stress.
(Tensile stress aur shear stress mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: In ka farq paida hone wali tabdeeli aur nateeja strain mein hai.

book_ref.quote: When a stress changes length, it is called the tensile stress

rows: Tensile strain ε = ΔL/L₀ paida karta hai.
Shear strain γ = Δx/y = tan θ paida karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
18 A force of 600 N acts on a wire of cross-sectional area 3.0 × 10⁻⁶ m². Find the stress.
(3.0 × 10⁻⁶ m² area wali taar par 600 N force lagti hai. Stress maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Mathematically, it is expressed as:

blocks.prompt:
19 A wire 1.5 m long is stretched by 0.30 mm. Find the strain.
(1.5 m lambi taar 0.30 mm khinch jati hai. Strain maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: ε = ΔL/L₀ = 0.30 × 10⁻³ / 1.5 = 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ (koi unit nahi).

book_ref.quote: If ΔL is the change in length and L₀ is the original length

blocks.prompt:
20 A wire under a stress of 1.2 × 10⁸ N m⁻² shows a strain of 6.0 × 10⁻⁴. Find Young's modulus.
(1.2 × 10⁸ N m⁻² stress par taar ka strain 6.0 × 10⁻⁴ hai. Young's modulus maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Y = stress/strain = 1.2 × 10⁸ / 6.0 × 10⁻⁴ = 2.0 × 10¹¹ N m⁻².

book_ref.quote: The stress applied per unit strain is called Young's modulus

blocks.prompt:
21 The top face of a block 10 cm thick slides 1.0 mm relative to the bottom under a shear stress. Find the shear strain and the angle θ.
(10 cm mote block ka oopar ka rukh shear stress se neeche ke muqable mein 1.0 mm khisakta hai. Shear strain aur angle θ maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: γ = Δx/y = 1.0 × 10⁻³ / 0.10 = 0.010. Chhote angle ke liye θ ≅ tan θ = 0.010 rad.

book_ref.quote: However, for small value of angle θ, measured in radian tanθ ≅ θ, so that

blocks.prompt:
22 Using Table 5.1, which is stiffer under tension, steel or aluminium? Give the reason.
(Table 5.1 ki madad se batayein ke khinchao mein steel zyada sakht (stiff) hai ya aluminium? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Steel. Is ka Young's modulus 200 × 10⁹ N m⁻² hai jab ke aluminium ka 70 × 10⁹ N m⁻²; is liye aik jaisa stress steel mein kam strain paida karta hai (strain = stress/Y).

book_ref.quote: Table 5.1: Elastic constants for some materials

blocks.text: 5.4 Determination of Young's modulus of a wire

blocks.prompt:
23 Why are two identical wires used in Searle's apparatus?
(Searle's apparatus mein do aik jaisi taarein kyun istemaal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Searle's apparatus mein reference (auxiliary) wire aur test wire baraabar lambai, aik material aur aik diameter ki hoti hain aur sakht support se latakti hain. Reference wire par mustaqil wazan hota hai; micrometer aur spirit level se sirf test wire ki us ke muqable mein extension naapi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: It consists of two wires, auxiliary or reference wire and test wire

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is the diameter of the test wire measured at several points in Searle's experiment?
(Searle's experiment mein test wire ka diameter kai jagah kyun naapa jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diameter screw gauge se taar ke kai muqamat par naap kar average liya jata hai taake stress = mg/πr² mein area A = πr² durust ho.

book_ref.quote: The diameter should be measured at several different points along the wire and take average.

blocks.prompt:
25 How is Young's modulus found from the graph in Searle's experiment?
(Searle's experiment mein graph se Young's modulus kaise maloom hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif bojh ke liye stress (mg/πr²) aur strain (ΔL/L₀) nikal kar stress-strain graph banaya jata hai. Yeh seedhi line hona chahiye; us ki slope taar ka Young's modulus hai.

book_ref.quote: Plot the above values on stress strain graph, it should be straight line.

blocks.text: 5.5 Elastic deformation, plastic deformation and elastic limit

blocks.prompt:
26 Differentiate between proportional limit and elastic limit.
(Proportional limit aur elastic limit mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ductile material ke stress-strain curve ke points hain.

book_ref.quote: From A to B, stress and strain are not proportional.

rows: Sab se zyada stress jis tak stress strain ke mutanasib (OA mein Hooke's law).
Sab se zyada stress jis tak material asal lambai par wapas aata hai (elastic hissa OB).

blocks.prompt:
27 State Hooke's law. In which region of the stress-strain curve is it obeyed?
(Hooke's law bayan karein. Stress-strain curve ke kis hisse mein lagu hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hooke's law: strain (bigaar) stress (force ya bojh) ke seedha mutanasib hai. Yeh hissa OA mein, proportional limit A tak lagu hai.

book_ref.quote: is obeyed in the region OA

blocks.prompt:
28 What is plastic deformation?
(Plastic deformation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar stress yield stress (elastic limit) se barh jaye to namoona mustaqil badal jata hai aur stress hatane par asal shakal ya size mein wapas nahi aata. Yeh plasticity hai; curve ka hissa B se C.

book_ref.quote: the specimen becomes permanently changed and does not recover its original shape

blocks.prompt:
29 Define ultimate tensile strength (UTS).
(Ultimate tensile strength (UTS) ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: UTS σᵤ woh zyada se zyada stress hai jo material bardasht kar sake (curve par point C); ise material ki nominal strength mana jata hai. C ke baad material D par toot jata hai (fracture stress σf).

book_ref.quote: can be regarded as the nominal strength of the material

blocks.prompt:
30 Differentiate between ductile and brittle substances.
(Ductile aur brittle ashya mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ductile ashya tootne se pehle plastic tor par bigarti hain; brittle elastic limit ke foran baad toot jati hain.

book_ref.quote: For example, Lead, copper and wrought iron are ductile substances.

rows: Tootne tak plastic deformation sehti hain.
Elastic limit tak pohanch kar foran toot jati hain.
Tootne se pehle bara plastic hissa.
Plastic hissa na hone ke baraabar.
Misalein: glass, high carbon steel, beryllium, bismuth, chromium.

blocks.prompt:
31 What is strain energy?
(Strain energy kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab force se jism deform hota hai to elastic restoring force ke khilaf kaam hota hai. Yeh kaam jism mein potential energy ke tor par jama hota hai, jo molecules ke apni mean jagah se hatne se P.E. mein izafa hai. Yahi strain energy hai.

book_ref.quote: It is stored in it as its potential energy

blocks.prompt:
32 Why is the work done in stretching a spring ½FΔx and not FΔx?
(Spring khenchne ka kaam ½FΔx kyun hai, FΔx kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Elastic limit ke andar extension force ke mutanasib hai, is liye force zero se F tak yaksaan barhti hai. Average force ½F hai aur kaam = average force × faasla = ½FΔx (= ½kΔx², tikon OPQ ka area).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the average force that stretches the spring through Δx is 1/2F.

blocks.prompt:
33 A spring of spring constant 250 N m⁻¹ is stretched by 0.20 m. Find the energy stored in it.
(250 N m⁻¹ spring constant wala spring 0.20 m khencha jata hai. Is mein jama energy maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Work done = Average force × Distance in the direction of the force

blocks.prompt:
34 Write strain energy per unit volume in terms of (i) stress and strain (ii) Young's modulus and strain.
(Fi unit hajm strain energy ko (i) stress aur strain (ii) Young's modulus aur strain ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: ½FΔL ko hajm AL se taqseem karne par: (i) U = ½ × (F/A) × (ΔL/L) = ½ × stress × strain. (ii) F/A = Y(ΔL/L) rakhne se: U = ½Y(ΔL/L)².

book_ref.quote: Hence, the strain energy per unit volume of the material will be given by

blocks.prompt:
35 A steel wire (Y = 2.0 × 10¹¹ N m⁻²) is under a strain of 1.0 × 10⁻³. Find the strain energy per unit volume.
(Steel ki taar (Y = 2.0 × 10¹¹ N m⁻²) par 1.0 × 10⁻³ strain hai. Fi unit hajm strain energy maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: From equation of Young's Modulus (Eq. 5.6), we have

blocks.prompt:
36 What does the area under a force-extension graph represent?
(Force-extension graph ke neeche ka area kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh material khenchne mein kiya gaya kaam (average force × extension) hai, jo material mein jama elastic P.E. (strain energy) ke baraabar hai.

book_ref.quote: Work done to stretch the material is also equal to elastic P.E. stored in the material.

blocks.prompt:
37 What is upthrust? Why does an object appear to lose weight in a liquid?
(Upthrust kya hai? Liquid mein cheez ka wazan kam kyun lagta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Upthrust woh oopar ki force hai jo liquid apne andar rakhi cheez par lagata hai. Yeh wazan ke mukhalif hai, is liye cheez halki lagti hai: zahiri wazan mein kami upthrust ke baraabar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: As a result, an apparent loss of weight is observed in the object.

blocks.prompt:
38 State Archimedes' principle.
(Archimedes' principle bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab koi cheez poori ya juzwi tor par liquid mein doobi ho to us par upthrust lagta hai jo hataye gaye liquid ke wazan ke baraabar hai: Upthrust = ρgV.

book_ref.quote: Archimedes' principle states that:

blocks.prompt:
39 Why is the force on the bottom face of an immersed cylinder greater than that on its top face?
(Doobe hue cylinder ke neeche wale rukh par force oopar wale rukh se zyada kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Liquid ka pressure gehraai ke saath barhta hai: P = ρgh. Neeche ka rukh zyada gehraai h₂ par hai, is liye F₂ = ρgh₂A, F₁ = ρgh₁A se zyada hai. In ka farq ρgA(h₂ − h₁) = ρgV hi upthrust hai.

book_ref.quote: This net force F on the cylinder is called the upthrust of the liquid.

blocks.prompt:
40 A body of volume 5.0 × 10⁻⁴ m³ is completely immersed in water. Find the upthrust on it.
(5.0 × 10⁻⁴ m³ hajm wala jism poora paani mein dooba hai. Us par upthrust maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: therefore, ρgV is the weight of the liquid displaced

blocks.prompt:
41 State the principle of floatation. When does an object float?
(Principle of floatation bayan karein. Cheez kab tairti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tairti cheez itna fluid hatati hai jis ka wazan us ke apne wazan ke baraabar ho. Cheez tab tairti hai jab us ka wazan upthrust ke baraabar ya kam ho; zyada ho to doob jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The upthrust is always equal to the weight of the fluid displaced by the object.

blocks.prompt:
42 A block of mass 0.80 kg floats on water. Find the upthrust and the volume of water it displaces.
(0.80 kg mass ka block paani par tairta hai. Upthrust aur hataye gaye paani ka hajm maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Tairti cheez: upthrust = wazan = 0.80 × 9.8 = 7.84 N. Hataye gaye paani ka mass 0.80 kg, is liye V = m/ρ = 0.80/1000 = 8.0 × 10⁻⁴ m³.

book_ref.quote: When an object floats in a fluid, the upthrust acting on it is equal to the weight of the object.

blocks.prompt:
43 How does a submarine dive and come up to the surface?
(Submarine paani mein kaise doobti aur sateh par kaise aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein tanks hote hain jo samandari paani se bhare ya khaali kiye jate hain. Bharne se wazan barhta hai aur upthrust se zyada hone par yeh doob jati hai. Tanks khaali karne se wazan upthrust se kam ho kar yeh sateh par aa jati hai.

book_ref.quote: A submarine can travel over as well as under water using the same principle of floatation.

blocks.prompt:
44 How is a hot-air balloon made to rise?
(Garam hawa ke balloon ko kaise oopar uthaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is mein garam hawa ki miqdaar badal kar is ki density aas paas ki hawa se kam ki jati hai. Jab buoyant force (hawa ka upthrust) wazan se zyada ho to yeh uthta aur tairta hai.

book_ref.quote: This is done by varying the quantity of hot air in the balloon.

blocks.prompt:
45 What is a streamline? Why can two streamlines not cross each other?
(Streamline kya hai? Do streamlines aik doosre ko kyun nahi kaat saktin?)
blocks.explanation: Streamline laminar bahao mein fluid ke zarron ka hamwar raasta hai; kisi nuqte par tangent bahao ki simt deta hai. Agar do streamlines kaatein to wahan zarra kisi bhi simt ja sakta hai aur bahao steady nahi rahega.

book_ref.quote: The smooth path followed by fluid particles in laminar flow is called a streamline.

blocks.prompt:
46 Define steady flow.
(Steady flow ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar bahao ka majmooi pattern waqt ke saath na badle to bahao steady hai. Har zarra pichhle zarre wali line par chalta hai; har nuqte par velocity waqt ke saath nahi badalti.

book_ref.quote: In steady flow, every particle of the fluid follows the same flow line as its previous particle.

blocks.prompt:
47 Write the three conditions of an ideal fluid.
(Ideal fluid ki teen sharait likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Non-viscous: saath wali tehon ke darmiyan ragar ki force nahi. (2) Incompressible: density mustaqil. (3) Is ka bahao steady hai.

book_ref.quote: The behaviour of the fluid which satisfies the following conditions is called ideal fluid:

blocks.prompt:
48 Show that rate of flow = Av.
(Sabit karein ke rate of flow = Av.)
blocks.explanation: Waqt t mein fluid area A wale pipe mein ℓ = vt faasla chalta hai. Guzarne wala hajm = Aℓ = Avt. Rate of flow = hajm/waqt = Avt/t = Av (unit m³ s⁻¹).

book_ref.quote: Consider a fluid flowing through a pipe of area of cross-section A

blocks.prompt:
49 Water flows at 4.0 m s⁻¹ through a pipe of area 5.0 × 10⁻⁴ m². Find the rate of flow in m³ s⁻¹ and in L s⁻¹.
(5.0 × 10⁻⁴ m² area wale pipe mein paani 4.0 m s⁻¹ se behta hai. Rate of flow m³ s⁻¹ aur L s⁻¹ mein maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Rate of flow = Av = 5.0 × 10⁻⁴ × 4.0 = 2.0 × 10⁻³ m³ s⁻¹ = 2.0 L s⁻¹ (1 m³ = 1000 L).

book_ref.quote: Sometimes, it is also measured in litres per second (L s⁻¹).

blocks.prompt:
50 State the equation of continuity.
(Equation of continuity bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Pipe ke kisi bhi nuqte par area aur fluid ki speed ka hasil-e-zarb Av mustaqil hai aur flow rate (fi second hajm) ke baraabar hai: A₁v₁ = A₂v₂.

book_ref.quote: This constant is equal to the volume flow per second of the fluid or simply the flow rate.

blocks.prompt:
51 Under what condition does A₁v₁ρ₁ = A₂v₂ρ₂ reduce to A₁v₁ = A₂v₂?
(A₁v₁ρ₁ = A₂v₂ρ₂ kis shart par A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ ban jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab fluid incompressible aur bahao steady ho to density mustaqil (ρ₁ = ρ₂) hoti hai, kat jati hai, aur A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ bachti hai.

book_ref.quote: Since density is constant for the steady flow of incompressible fluid

blocks.prompt:
52 Water enters a pipe of diameter 4.0 cm at 1.0 m s⁻¹. Find its speed where the diameter is 2.0 cm.
(Paani 4.0 cm diameter wale pipe mein 1.0 m s⁻¹ se dakhil hota hai. Jahan diameter 2.0 cm ho wahan speed maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: A ∝ d², is liye A₁/A₂ = (4.0/2.0)² = 4. v₂ = A₁v₁/A₂ = 4 × 1.0 = 4.0 m s⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Equation (5.18) states that in steady flow, the rate of flow inward is equal to the rate of flow outward.

blocks.prompt:
53 Why does a stream of water from a tap become narrower as it falls?
(Nalkay se girti paani ki dhaar neeche ja kar patli kyun ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Girte hue paani ki speed barhti hai. Equation of continuity ke mutabiq Av mustaqil hai, is liye area kam hona zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: As the water falls, its speed increases and so its cross sectional area decreases

blocks.prompt:
54 Why does water come out faster when the end of a rubber pipe is squeezed?
(Rubber pipe ka sira dabane se paani tez kyun nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dabane se area kam hota hai (A₂ < A₁). A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ ke mutabiq wahi flow rate rakhne ke liye v₂ ko barhna parta hai.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, squeezing the rubber pipe increases the flow velocity of water.

blocks.prompt:
55 State Bernoulli's equation and its assumptions.
(Bernoulli's equation aur us ke mafroozat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: P + ½ρv² + ρgh = mustaqil. Mafroozat: fluid incompressible, non-viscous hai aur steady behta hai.

book_ref.quote: In deriving Bernoulli's equation, we assume that the fluid is incompressible

blocks.prompt:
56 What is the meaning of each term in P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant?
(P + ½ρv² + ρgh = constant mein har term ka kya matlab hai?)
blocks.explanation: P pressure hai; ½ρv² fi unit hajm K.E. hai; ρgh fi unit hajm gravitational P.E. hai. In ka jama mustaqil rehta hai, jo behte fluid ke liye energy ka conservation hai.

book_ref.quote: Bernoulli's equation and is often expressed as:

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Bernoulli ki equation (5.24) ko m/ρ yani hajm V se taqseem karne par har term fi unit hajm energy ban jati hai: ½mv²/V = ½ρv² aur mgh/V = ρgh.

blocks.prompt:
57 Water flows in a horizontal pipe. At one point P₁ = 1.20 × 10⁵ Pa and v₁ = 1.0 m s⁻¹; at another v₂ = 3.0 m s⁻¹. Find P₂.
(Ufuqi pipe mein paani behta hai. Aik jagah P₁ = 1.20 × 10⁵ Pa aur v₁ = 1.0 m s⁻¹; doosri jagah v₂ = 3.0 m s⁻¹. P₂ maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ufuqi pipe, h₁ = h₂: P₂ = P₁ − ½ρ(v₂² − v₁²) = 1.20 × 10⁵ − 4000 = 1.16 × 10⁵ Pa.

book_ref.quote: As the fluid moves through a pipe of varying cross-section and height, the pressure will change along the pipe.

blocks.prompt:
58 How does an aeroplane wing get its lift?
(Hawai jahaz ke par ko lift kaise milti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Par hawa ko is tarah morta hai ke oopar streamlines neeche se zyada qareeb hon. Oopar hawa tez hai, is liye Bernoulli ke mutabiq oopar pressure kam hai. Neeche ka zyada pressure par ko oopar dhakelta hai: yahi lift hai.

book_ref.quote: The pressure will be lower at the top of the wing

blocks.prompt:
59 Explain the swing of a ball using Bernoulli's equation.
(Bernoulli's equation se ball ki swing samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq ball ki aik taraf hawa tez aur doosri taraf aahista chalti hai. Tez hawa ka pressure kam aur aahista hawa ka zyada hota hai; yeh farq side ki force deta hai (kitab ise Magnus effect kehti hai) jis se ball mur jati hai.

book_ref.quote: known as Magnus effect which causes the ball to curves in the air

blocks.prompt:
60 How does a filter pump work?
(Filter pump kaise kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ke beech mein tang hissa hai jahan nalkay ki paani ki dhaar tez ho jati hai. Is se wahan pressure girta hai aur side tube se hawa andar aati hai; hawa aur paani mil kar neeche se nikal jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The air and water together are expelled through the lower part of the pump.

blocks.prompt:
61 How does the carburetor of a car engine use Bernoulli's principle?
(Car engine ka carburetor Bernoulli's principle kaise istemaal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Venturi duct mein hawa bohat tez guzarti hai jis se duct mein pressure kam hota hai. Yeh side ke chhote inlet se petrol ko bukharat ki shakal mein hawa mein kheench leta hai aur cylinders ko sahi mixture milta hai.

book_ref.quote: which draws petrol vapours into the air stream

blocks.prompt:
62 How does a perfume atomizer or paint sprayer work?
(Perfume atomizer ya paint sprayer kaise kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rubber ki gend dabane se hawa tube se tang suraakh par tezi se nikalti hai aur wahan pressure girta hai. Phir atmospheric pressure liquid ko tube mein oopar dhakel kar hawa ki dhaar mein le aata hai.

book_ref.quote: This effect is used in perfume bottles and paint sprayers.

blocks.prompt:
63 Why is the ρgh term dropped in deriving the Venturi relation?
(Venturi relation derive karte waqt ρgh term kyun chhor di jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Venturi pipe ufuqi rakha jata hai, is liye dono jagah average potential energy (unchai) aik hai. Dono taraf ρgh baraabar ho kar kat jati hai aur P₁ + ½ρv₁² = P₂ + ½ρv₂² bachti hai.

book_ref.quote: As the pipe is placed horizontally, therefore, we consider that average potential energy is the same at both places

blocks.prompt:
64 In a venturi meter carrying water, the speed in the narrow part is 5.0 m s⁻¹. Find P₁ − P₂ using the Venturi relation.
(Paani wale venturi meter ke tang hisse mein speed 5.0 m s⁻¹ hai. Venturi relation se P₁ − P₂ maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Thus, the speed of the fluid is very slow in wider portion of the pipe

blocks.prompt:
65 State Torricelli's theorem. Why is the speed of the top surface taken as zero?
(Torricelli's theorem bayan karein. Oopar ki sateh ki speed zero kyun li jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Efflux ki speed us velocity ke baraabar hai jo fluid (h₁ − h₂) unchai se gravity ke tehat girne par pata hai: v = √(2g(h₁ − h₂)). Suraakh itne chhote hain ke efflux speed oopar ki sateh ki speed se bohat zyada hai, is liye v₁ ≈ 0.

book_ref.quote: We can therefore, take v₁ as approximately zero.

blocks.prompt:
66 Water stands 0.80 m above a small hole in a tank. Find the speed of efflux.
(Tank mein paani chhote suraakh se 0.80 m oopar hai. Efflux ki speed maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: v = √(2 × 9.8 × 0.80) = √15.7 = 3.96 ≈ 4.0 m s⁻¹ (amalan viscous nuqsaan se thori kam).

book_ref.quote: In practice, viscous-energy losses would alter the result to some extent.

blocks.prompt:
67 What does the coefficient of viscosity tell us? Which has the larger value, honey or water?
(Coefficient of viscosity kya batata hai? Shehad aur paani mein kis ka zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh (η) batata hai ke liquid ki aik teh ko doosri par khiskane ke liye kitni force chahiye, yani tehon ke darmiyan ragar. Shehad aasaani se nahi behta, is liye us ka η zyada hai; paani ka kam.

book_ref.quote: Substances which flow easily, like water, have small coefficient of viscosities.

blocks.prompt:
68 What is drag force? How does it depend on speed?
(Drag force kya hai? Yeh speed par kaise munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fluid mein chalti cheez par rokne wali force drag force hai. Yeh speed barhne se barhti hai; hawa ki thori viscosity bhi tez car par bari drag deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Even the small viscosity of the air causes a large retarding force on a car as it travels at high speed.

blocks.prompt:
69 State Stokes' law. When is it valid?
(Stokes' law bayan karein. Yeh kab durust hai?)
blocks.explanation: η viscosity wale fluid mein v speed se aahista chalte r radius ke kurre par drag force F = 6πηrv hai. Yeh aahista harkat ke liye hai; tez speed par force speed ke seedha mutanasib nahi rehti.

book_ref.quote: However, the case of a sphere moving through a fluid is of great importance.

blocks.prompt:
70 A sphere of radius 1.0 × 10⁻⁴ m moves through air (η = 1.9 × 10⁻⁵ N s m⁻²) at 1.0 m s⁻¹. Find the drag force by Stokes' law.
(1.0 × 10⁻⁴ m radius ka kurra hawa (η = 1.9 × 10⁻⁵ N s m⁻²) mein 1.0 m s⁻¹ se chalta hai. Stokes' law se drag force maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Since liquids and gases have non zero viscosity, therefore, a force is required

blocks.prompt:
71 Why does a tall chimney exposed to air currents work best?
(Hawa ke jhonkon ke saamne lambi chimney behtar kyun kaam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lambi chimney ke oopar chalti hawa wahan pressure kam karti hai. Neeche ka zyada pressure dhuen ko oopar ki taraf dhakelta hai.

book_ref.quote: A chimney works best when it is tall and exposed to air currents, which reduces

blocks.prompt:
72 What is terminal velocity?
(Terminal velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Girta qatra tez hota hai to oopar ki drag barhti hai yahan tak ke wazan ke baraabar ho jaye. Phir net force (wazan − drag) zero hoti hai aur qatra mustaqil speed se girta hai jise terminal velocity kehte hain: vₜ = 2gr²ρ/9η.

book_ref.quote: the drag force eventually approaches the weight in the magnitude

blocks.prompt:
73 Why does a fog droplet fall more slowly than a raindrop?
(Kohre ka qatra baarish ke qatre se aahista kyun girta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Terminal velocity vₜ = 2gr²ρ/9η, r² ke mutanasib hai. Kohre ke qatre ka radius bohat chhota hai, is liye us ki terminal velocity bohat kam hai.

book_ref.quote: The droplet accelerates rapidly under the over powering force of gravity

blocks.prompt:
74 Find the terminal velocity of a water droplet of radius 3.0 × 10⁻⁵ m falling through air (η = 1.9 × 10⁻⁵ kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹).
(3.0 × 10⁻⁵ m radius ke paani ke qatre ki hawa (η = 1.9 × 10⁻⁵ kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹) mein terminal velocity maloom karein.)

book_ref.quote: Given that η for air = 19 x 10⁻⁶ kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ and density of water ρ = 1000 kg m⁻³.

blocks.prompt:
75 How does a parachute help a person land safely?
(Parachute insaan ko mehfooz utarne mein kaise madad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka bara sateh ka area hawa ki rukawat (drag) barhata hai jo gravity ka muqabla karti hai. Drag jaldi wazan ke baraabar ho kar kam terminal speed deti hai, is liye girna aahista ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This slows down the persons fall, allowing them to land safely.

blocks.prompt:
76 Give three differences between an ideal fluid and a real fluid.
(Ideal fluid aur real fluid ke teen farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Ideal fluid sirf nazariye mein hai; real fluids qudrat mein maujood hain.

book_ref.quote: Ideal fluids are incompressible.

rows: Qudrat mein maujood, maslan paani, petrol, shehad.

blocks.prompt:
77 Why is the bulk modulus of an ideal fluid infinite?
(Ideal fluid ka bulk modulus la-mehdood kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bulk modulus hajm ki tabdeeli ke ulat mutanasib hai. Ideal fluid incompressible hai, us ka hajm nahi badalta, is liye bulk modulus la-mehdood hai.

book_ref.quote: Bulk modulus inversely depends on the volume change.

blocks.prompt:
78 What is superfluidity?
(Superfluidity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Superfluidity fluid ki zero viscosity (be-ragar bahao) ki khasiyat hai; aisi shay superfluid hai. Yeh kinetic energy khoye baghair behta hai aur absolute zero ke qareeb cryogenic temperature par banta hai.

book_ref.quote: A substance exhibiting this property is superfluid.

blocks.prompt:
79 Write two properties of superfluids not seen in ordinary fluids.
(Superfluids ki do khususiyaat likhein jo aam fluids mein nahi hotin.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Film flow: yeh bartan ki deewaron par charh kar nikal sakte hain. (2) Hilane par mustaqil bhanwar (vortices) bante hain, aur bartan ghumane par andar ka liquid saakin rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: When stirred, superfluids create persistent vortices, unlike regular fluids that settle.

blocks.prompt:
80 Is a superfluid also a superconductor? Explain.
(Kya superfluid superconductor bhi hota hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Superfluidity (zero viscosity) superconductivity se mukhtalif hai; maslan superfluid helium-3 aur helium-4 bijli nahi guzaarte.

book_ref.quote: It is important to note that superfluidity differs from superconductivity

blocks.prompt:
81 Name two substances other than helium-4 that show superfluidity.
(Helium-4 ke ilawa do ashya ke naam likhein jo superfluidity dikhati hain.)
blocks.explanation: Superfluid helium-3 aur lithium-6 atoms (50 nK par). Mazeed: kuch Bose Einstein condensates, atomic rubidium-85, atomic sodium, aur shayad neutron stars ka andar.
